reason: I'd probably start the trial like I do with every growth tool, but three days isn't enough to see if cold DMs turn into booked calls, and I'd cancel before day 4 unless something proved itself. $147 isn't the issue, not knowing if it works is.
objection: No reviews, no case studies, no customer results published. How do I know it books calls and doesn't just write nice-looking DMs? And three days is too short to find out, since replies and bookings take longer than that.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from agency owners like me, such as reply and booked-call numbers from named customers, or a longer trial (7 to 14 days) so I can see actual replies before I'm charged.
